src/llm-provider-anthropic.ts.name: Anthropic format
src/llm-provider-anthropic.ts.description: Translates AI requests, replies and streamed answers to and from Anthropic's message format, tool calls included.

src/llm-provider-blocks.ts.name: Answer block builder
src/llm-provider-blocks.ts.description: Turns streamed fragments from any provider into ordered start, delta and end events and a matching final answer.

src/llm-provider-gemini.ts.name: Google Gemini format
src/llm-provider-gemini.ts.description: Translates AI requests, replies and streamed answers to and from Google Gemini's format, tool calls included.

src/llm-provider-http.ts.name: Provider presets and web caller
src/llm-provider-http.ts.description: Lists ready-made settings for well-known AI providers and sends requests to them over the web, buffered or streamed.

src/llm-provider-openai.ts.name: OpenAI chat format
src/llm-provider-openai.ts.description: Translates AI requests, replies and streamed answers to and from OpenAI's chat completions format, tool calls included.

src/llm-provider-shared.ts.name: Shared provider helpers
src/llm-provider-shared.ts.description: Holds the types, defaults and small helpers every provider format shares, such as which header carries the provider key, the default answer length and usage counting.

src/llm-provider-stream.ts.name: Streamed answer reader
src/llm-provider-stream.ts.description: Reads a provider's streamed reply piece by piece and picks the right translator for that provider's format.

src/llm-providers.ts.name: Provider format switch
src/llm-providers.ts.description: Builds the outgoing request and reads the reply for whichever provider format a connection uses.
